articles.title: ITV (LSE:ITV) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Analyst Caution On Sky Deal
articles.summary: ITV is back in focus after analysts reset price targets closer to £0.85 per share, alongside an updated fair value estimate of about £0.81. These revisions come as commentary turns more cautious around the proposed £1.6b sale of ITV Media & Entertainment to Sky and what that could mean for valuation, growth profile and execution risk. articles.title: ITV PLC (ITVPF) (H1 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Strategic M&A Sale and Digital Momentum ...
articles.summary: ITV PLC (ITVPF) delivered a solid H1 performance with both divisions achieving revenue growth, including a 2% increase in ITV Studios revenue and a 3% rise in total advertising revenue. The sale of the M&A business to Sky is a transformative deal that will unlock significant shareholder value, including a 950 million net cash return and a 100 million share buyback. ITVX continues to show strong momentum with viewing up 27% and digital revenues growing 13%, reaching over 20 million monthly active users in June.
